name: SPHEREx
tagline: A map of the whole sky in 102 infrared colours; first map finished December 2025
description: SPHEREx is NASA's all-sky infrared survey observatory: it maps the whole sky in 102 wavelength bands. It is 2.6 m tall and 3.2 m wide, with a mass of 502 kg and a 20 cm telescope inside three concentric photon shields. BAE Systems built the spacecraft bus, and Caltech and JPL built the payload. It launched on a Falcon 9 from Vandenberg on 2025-03-12 at 03:10 UTC (11 March in the US), sharing the rocket with the four PUNCH satellites, and flies a polar orbit of about 98 minutes along the day-night terminator. Mapping began in May 2025, and the first all-sky map was completed in December 2025; four maps are planned for the prime mission.
best_known_for: NASA's all-sky infrared spectral survey: launched in March 2025, first full map finished in December 2025
